about: Alfred and Plantagenet is a township in Prescott-Russell, Ontario, on the Ottawa River between Ottawa and Hawkesbury—not a city. Villages such as Plantagenet, Alfred, Wendover, and Lefaivre sit among Franco-Ontarian farmland and river lots. About 10,000 people live in Alfred and Plantagenet Township.
